question.text: Ethical selling of Cat III AIFs to an unsuitable client is:

answer.text: Prohibited — product must be suitable before any recommendation

explanation.text: The Logic: Distributors must consider investor interest, risk profiling and suitability before marketing, advising or pitching Cat III AIF schemes (pp. 344-345). The Trap: Other options rationalise mis-selling; disclosure or client agreement does not cure unsuitability. Note: Failing to take reasonable care on suitability may amount to a fraudulent or unfair trade practice (p. 348).
